subject: MAP: Load validation & traffic replay — scheduling and capacity proposal
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Load validation & replay milestone — scheduling proposal

Hi Lara,

Thanks for taking time today — good conversation. Quick recap plus a proposed set of MAP milestones for the load/perf validation run we discussed.

Goal: Run a traffic replay that simulates your upcoming holiday peak (target: 85k sustained QPS, 150k peak burst) to validate routing, KV cache behavior, autoscaling, and failure modes.

Proposed Milestones (draft):
- M1: Replay trace handoff — ACME -> Redwood
  - Owner: Lara Chen (ACME)
  - Due: 2027-06-04
  - Dependency: export of production traces (last 30 days, anonymized)
- M2: Replay dry-run (10% traffic, smoke)
  - Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
  - Due: 2027-06-08
- M3: Full-scale replay & peak ramp
  - Owner: Priyom Das (Redwood) / ACME Ops
  - Due: 2027-06-15
  - Dependency: dedicated capacity reservation & load generator IP allowlist
- M4: Post-replay analysis & action items
  - Owner: Aditya Rao (Redwood)
  - Due: 2027-06-18

Initial capacity ask (preliminary): reserved equivalent of 8x A100-class GPUs for the primary window + 2x buffer for failover/parallelism. We'll refine sizing after we process the trace sample.

Immediate next steps I recommend:
1) ACME to send a 24–72 hour trace sample and confirm target peak QPS range.
2) Redwood to produce a test runbook and capacity quote (T+48h after trace receipt).
3) Agree on MAP milestone sign-off & lock a tentative window — my suggestion: week of 2027-06-14 for the full replay.

I've attached a short MAP draft and a replay checklist. If this looks good, can we lock a tentative window the week of 6/14? Also please confirm who will own the anonymization of the traces (ACME or a neutral third party).

Thanks,
Aditya
--
Aditya Rao

aditya_rao@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Lara Chen <lara@acme-retail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ron Kim <ron.kim@acme-retail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load validation & replay milestone — scheduling proposal

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear milestones. A few quick notes/questions from ACME Ops and security: 

- We can export a 48-hour trace slice and will anonymize IPs and user IDs. I need to confirm whether we can include headers for routing analysis; if not, we'll send a stripped sample.
- SOC 2 evidence: our procurement team asked for a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 report and an outline of logging retention for replay artifacts. Can you loop in security or point me to the SOC 2 doc?
- On capacity: 8x A100 sounds reasonable as a starting point. We'll likely ask for a smaller dry-run first.

Action: I'll share the trace sample by 2027-06-04 EOD and copy Ron (ACME infra) for IP allowlist coordination.

Also: procurement will want a short statement on data handling during the replay (how long traces are stored, who has access).

Best,
Lara
Lara Chen
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Retail
lara@acme-retail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP: Load validation & replay milestone — sizing notes

Aditya / Priyom,

Thanks — quick internal ops note to inform the quote and runbook:

- Based on the target QPS range (85k sustained, 150k peak), our estimate is closer to a 6xA100 dedicated baseline with an autoscale buffer to 10x for peak ramps. The 8x you proposed is safe; 6x baseline + burst to 10x keeps cost lower and is operationally simpler for short windows.
- Load generation: we'll run distributed traffic generators in 3 regions to mirror ACME's prod split. Need ACME to provide source IP blocks for allowlisting at least 48 hours before the window.
- KV cache behavior: to stress KV we should include a 30% randomized cache-miss profile in the replay trace. If ACME cannot provide header-level traces, we'll augment the sample with synthetic miss patterns.

I've attached a short sizing runbook and a template for the IP allowlist request. Once we have the trace I'll run a quick local sizing job and send the formal quote.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- sizing_runbook.pdf (pdf)
- ip_allowlist_template.txt (text)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ron Kim <ron.kim@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP: Load validation & replay milestone — scheduling and follow-ups

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. Confirming agreed items and next actions so we have a single MAP view: 

Agreed MAP milestones (finalized):
- M1 (trace handoff): ACME to provide anonymized 48h trace sample — owner: Lara — due: 2027-06-04 (ACME will confirm header inclusion).
- M2 (dry-run): Redwood to execute 10% traffic dry-run and smoke checks — owner: Marissa — target: 2027-06-08.
- M3 (full replay): Redwood + ACME to run full-scale replay with peak ramp — owners: Priyom (Redwood) & Ron (ACME) — target window: 2027-06-15 — capacity: baseline 6x A100 + autoscale to 10x (reserve 8x initially per ACME ask, but will provision burst as needed).
- M4 (analysis & close): Shared results, regression list, and follow-ups — owner: Aditya — due: 2027-06-18.

Dependencies / open items:
- SOC2 report & data handling statement from Redwood (Aditya to attach).
- ACME to provide trace sample and IP blocks for allowlist by 6/4.
- Procurement: pricing sign-off for reserved capacity (we will send a 48h quote after trace review).

Target close for this MAP (commercial close + replay completion): 2027-06-30. Deal: ACME-2027-47.

Next immediate actions (owner / ETA):
1) Lara -> share trace sample (by 2027-06-04) and confirm headers (ACME).
2) Aditya -> attach SOC2 and data handling memo to this thread (by EOD 2027-06-03).
3) Marissa -> run initial sizing after sample and share quote (T+48h).
4) Priyom -> prepare capacity reservation draft and IP allowlist steps (by 2027-06-06).

I'll follow up with a formal MAP document (signed XLSX) once ACME confirms the trace handoff. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-47.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Aditya
